_source: overhead 2/Gui/StatusBox.vb renderStatus, Gui/HeroScreen.vb renderheroScreen, Gui/Messages.vb, Fonts.vb, Root.Write, RECONSTRUCTION 6.1 and 13. Positions are pixels of the 640 x 480 screen the original drew on (the window stretched it); Write drew text left and top aligned at the point, in the colour (a, r, g, b).

clock._note: renderStatus writes the day period's name at (5, iHeight - 70) and the time at (5, iHeight - 57) in fontCalisto, (128, 255, 255, 0).

heroScreen._note: Gui/HeroScreen.vb renderheroScreen while bHeroScreen is on (Page Up, once a press): menu.png (loaded at 256 x 256) stretched over heroScreenWidth x heroScreenheight (600 x 430) at heroScreenOffset (20, 20) (its top edge's v was 2 / 600 and 2 / 430, under half a pixel row cropped; not reproduced), then the date line at (iWidth - 250, 25) and the time line (time, two spaces, period) at (iWidth - 250, 45) in fontCalisto, (128, 255, 255, 0). The icon quad it also built (itemIconSize at +(260, 10)) was never drawn. The experience line is the rebuild's (BIBLE 'Quest Exp use'): the party's experience on the next line, in the same font and colour.

options._note: Gui/Options.vb renderOptionMenu while bOptions is on (F11; Escape in the rebuild, BIBLE 'Pause'): menu.png (loaded at 256 x 256) stretched over menuWidth x menuHeight (255 x 255) at (10, 10) (its top edge's v was 2 / 255; not reproduced); 'Options' at (28, 20) in fontArialNarrow24, (255, 0, 255, 255); '>' at (50, the chosen row's y) and the page's rows at (60, y) in fontArial white. maxOptions is 3 on every page: Up and Down (once a press, optionUp / optionDown) step the cursor through rows 0 to 3, wrapping; Left goes back to the main page (the first); Enter (or the left button, actionPickup) on the main page opens the row's page, or quits on Exit. The Controls page lists keyLeft ... keyDown by their DirectInput names. The Video and Audio pages had no rows and no positions of their own (optionPos(2, n) was never set, so the cursor sat at y 0; optionPos(3, n) is past the table, so the Audio page threw every frame and froze the screen); they use the Controls page's rows here (BIBLE).

fps._note: Gui/Fps.vb renderFPS (F4, on at start): every iFPSProfileSpeed (100) ms the frames counted since become the rate (count x 1000 / 100), written as 'n fps' at (iWidth - 50, 4) in fontArial, (255, 255, 0, 25): red. The original counted only while on but wrote the stale number while off; the rebuild writes nothing while off (BIBLE).

pause._note: Engine.oneFrameRender's last write while bPause is on: '- PAUSE -' at (iWidth / 2 - 64, iHeight / 2 - 30) in fontArialNarrow24 white. No key set it in the original (BIBLE 'Pause').
pause.caption: - PAUSE -

turnBars._note: Gui/TurnBar.vb renderTurnBar, every frame after renderStatus: the leader's bar in the first slot and, in team mode, the other heroes' in party order in the next; each a TurnbarWidth x TurnbarHeight (60 x 13) fill quad TurnbarWidth x stamina / maxStamina wide (VB Integer, half to even; never below 0) carrying the whole stamina_fill picture, under ready_bar when the hero's stamina is full and stamina_bar otherwise (the pictures loaded at 87 x 13, stretched). A fourth slot at (300, 59) was never used (three heroes).

cursor2D._note: Cursor/Cursor2D.vb rendercursor2D, the frame's last draw: while the virtual mouse is over the open inventory panel, the team button or the inventory button (the buttons' hit boxes), cursor_arrow (arrow.png) 28 x 28 at the mouse + (-9, +4), and renderCursor does not draw the world cursor; renderCursor also leaves it out while an item's target is being chosen (bHeroSelect).

hoverName._note: Cursor.checkCursorOverHero: with the world cursor over a hero other than the leader (the first hero it is over, Party.HeroAt), renderText's '.' (scale 0.02) and the hero's name (0.007) at (x + heroSize / 2 + 0.005, y - heroSize / 2 + 0.1), or + 0.08 while it kneels, in the world's light.

tutorial._note: Root.sayTutorial, at start and on Reset: these 88 lines queued as messages in fontArial white, the blanks spacing them out. The original's 'INSERT - Toggle INVENTORY' named the wrong key (Insert recalls the console's last script; Delete opens the pack): it says DELETE here (BIBLE).
lines: Pickup items by pressing Left Mouse

loading._note: frmMain.Startup: a random one of gfx/gui/load/load640_1 to 12 (getRndInt(1, 12)) as the form's background while the engine loaded, gone once the game ran. The rebuild loads in a moment, so it holds the picture 'seconds' before play starts (BIBLE).

statusBox._note: Gui/StatusBox.vb renderStatus (status_box.png is loaded but its draw is commented out, so only the text shows): at (statOffsetX, statOffsetY) = (x, y), the leader's name at +name, written '  Name  ' in white; then 'HP n', 'MP n' and 'AP n' at +value and '  / max' at +maximum, each row rowSpacing lower, in (255, 255 - r, 255, 255 - b) of the world light (r, g, b), so green by day. In team mode the other heroes follow at +teamSpacing each, their names in (255, 255 - r, 255, b). A hero in battle mode has one more line at +battle in battleFont: below its maximum stamina, its share as a whole percent (VB's CInt, half to even) written 'NN %' for the leader and 'NN%' for the others, in (255 x percent / 100, 255 - r, 255, b), so it fades in as the gauge fills; full, 'Ready!' in (255, 255, 255, b) for the leader and (255, 255 - r, 255, b) for the others. While an item's target is being chosen (bHeroSelect), the chosen hero's name is written chosenText ('|Name|') in chosenColour (yellow) instead.

bars._note: Gui/HealthBar.vb, ManaBar.vb and StaminaBar.vb: the leader's bars at the bottom left, width x height, the fill drawn first and the bar over it; the fill quad is width x value / max wide (rounded to a whole pixel, as VB's Integer assignment did, never below 0) with the whole fill picture on it. The mana bar reuses health_bar.png.

rest._note: Engine.showRestText: while the leader is laid and kneeling, 'Rest for n hour?' (n = 1) or 'Rest for n hours?' is written at (iWidth / 2 - 100, iHeight / 2 - 20) in fontArialNarrow24, (255, 255, 255, 255). The HUD is not dimmed by a sleep's fade.

examine._note: Gui/ExamineBox.vb renderExamine: in examine mode, with the cursor over an unpicked pickup, examine.png stretched over 328 x 175 at (292, 112), the pickup's world picture 32 x 32 (itemIconSize) at +(15, 10), then in fontArial white: the name at +(50, 20), the effect at +(20, 45), 'Description:' and the description below it at +(20, 75), 'Weight: ' at +(20, 125) and 'Value: ' with strCurrency '$' at +(20, 145).

inventory._note: Inventory.vb: inventory.png (332 x 385) drawn over 345 x 400 at (iWidth - 345 - 12, iHeight - 400 - 50); icon slots of 32 px from the panel + (8, 8), 32 apart, ten to a row (the wrap test is iconCols > 32 * 9), rows 40 apart, 101 of them; item_cursor.png on the selected icon and swap_cursor.png on the icon marked for a swap. In fontArial: 'Weight: n / limit' (FormatNumber(x, 1)) at +(345 - 120, 400 - 22) and 'Gold: n' at +(12, 400 - 22) in (255, 128, 255, 128); with a stack selected its name (with ' x n' over one) at +(12, 400 - 110) and its weight at +(345 - 30, 400 - 110) in that green, its effect at +(12, 400 - 92) and description at +(12, 400 - 66) in (255, 0, 255, 255), and '$' and its value at +(345 - 24 - 6 per character, 400 - 44) in the green. Every stack over one writes its count in fontAmount at its icon + (14, 24), or + (12, 24) past 9, in (255, 0, 255, 255).

quickBar._note: QuickBar.vb: quick_bar.png (470 x 47) drawn over 400 x 36 at (iWidth - 400 - 2, iHeight - 36 - 2) while bQuickBar is on (Q); the first ten stacks' icons, 32 px, at the bar + (1 + 40 n, 0), drawn before the bar, each count over one in fontAmount at the icon + (16, 18), or + (15, 18) past 9.

inventoryButton._note: Gui/InventoryBtn.vb and Cursor2D.rendercursor2D: a 28 x 28 square at (18, 104) showing inventory_Open while the panel is open and inventory_Closed otherwise (32 x 30 pictures stretched to it); the left button toggles the panel while the virtual mouse is across its width and between its top - 10 and its bottom - 12.

burdened._note: StatusBox.renderStatus: while the leader is burdened, 'You are overburdened' at (centerScreen.X - 75, centerScreen.Y) in fontCalisto, in the status box's (255, 255 - r, 255, 255 - b) of the world light.

target._note: HeroSelect.renderHeroSelect: while an item's target is being chosen, select_hero.png on the chosen hero's quad (heroSize square at its position), and renderText's '.' (scale 0.02) and its name (0.007) at (x + heroSize / 2 + 0.005, y - heroSize / 2 + 0.1), in the world's light.

questScreen._note: Gui/QuestScreen.vb renderQuestScreen while bQuestScreen is on (Page Down): the page's picture (quest_screen_main, _subquests for the list and a subquest's page, _completed; loaded at 579 x 420) on the QuestWidth x Questheight (600 x 430) quad at QuestOffset (20, 20) (its top edge's v was 2 / 600 and 2 / 430 rather than 0, which crops under half a pixel row of the picture; not reproduced), then in fontArial: the quest's text at +(160, 25), and the lines at +(160, 60 + 20 n): '~ text' for an open objective in (255, 255, 255, 255), 'X text' for a completed one in (128, 255, 255, 255), the subquests by name in white with the chosen one in (255, 255, 255, 128), and 'o text' for each Success main quest at its own index's line in (128, 255, 255, 255). showQuestPoints (called every frame, open or not) draws renderText's '*' at scale 0.02 at every incomplete objective of every main quest and of every Active subquest, centred, in the world's light.

book._note: Book.vb renderBook while bBook is on: texBook (book.png, or book_brown / book_blue once CHANGE BOOK COVER names them; loaded at 550 x 392) on the BookWidth x BookHeight (600 x 450) quad at bookOffset (20, 20) (its top edge's v was 2 / 600 and 2 / 450 rather than 0, which crops under a pixel row of the picture; not reproduced), then the pages currPage and currPage + 1 at +(30, 30) and +(320, 30) in the book's font, and their numbers at +(150, 405) and +(440, 405) in fontAmount, all (255, 0, 0, 0). The page files are hand-wrapped and drawn as they are. loadBooks loads 'Grimoire de'Alchemiste' in fontCorsiva8 with Roman numerals; every loadBook call numbers Roman; frmMain's N loads the next book in fontCorsiva. The letterings are cmdChangeBook's FONT words; SYMBOL did nothing.

messages._note: Messages.vb: up to maxMessages waiting (a message added to a full queue replaces the last); the next is shown at the screen centre, x less 6 / 2 per character, once the last shown is more than 'spacing' pixels below the centre or gone; each shown message loses 'fade' alpha and drops 'drift' pixels a tick, starting at alpha 255, and is gone at 0. The period announcements use fontArialNarrow24 in white.
